seo.meta_description: Array Behavioral Care is the largest B2B telepsychiatry provider in the US, partnering with 450+ hospitals. Enterprise contracts only—not direct-to-consumer.

faqs.q: Can I sign up for Array Behavioral Care as a patient?
faqs.a: No. Array is a B2B enterprise service for hospitals and health systems, not a direct-to-consumer platform. You access Array's psychiatrists through a hospital or health system that contracts with them, not by signing up yourself.

faqs.q: What is Array Behavioral Care actually used for?
faqs.a: Hospitals and health systems contract with Array to provide on-demand telepsychiatry. When a patient in an ED needs psychiatric evaluation at 2am and no psychiatrist is on-site, Array provides remote coverage. They also staff inpatient psychiatric units and outpatient clinics.

faqs.q: How big is Array Behavioral Care?
faqs.a: The largest telepsychiatry provider in the US. They partner with 450+ hospitals and health systems, and their insurance network covers 90M+ Americans. Founded in 1999 as a local NJ practice, grew through mergers including InSight + Regroup.

Yes. In 2024 they partnered with KeyCare (Epic-based virtual care platform) for seamless EHR integration. This means Array psychiatrists can document directly in the hospital's Epic system rather than creating separate records.

Launched August 2025, Care Pathways is Array's proprietary framework for standardized, measurement-based treatment protocols. It ensures consistent care across their network and enables outcome tracking across virtual outpatient services.

faqs.q: How does Array compare to Iris Telehealth or Genoa Telepsychiatry?
faqs.a: Array is the largest by scale (450+ hospital partners). All three serve the B2B market providing telepsychiatry to health systems. Array's differentiators are their Epic/KeyCare integration and the new Care Pathways outcome measurement system.
